b: It’s the 30th anniversary of the Command & Conquer Red Alert series this month so I thought I’d highlight some of the great Sid Meier’s Civilization mods based on the Red Alert franchise at CivFanatics. To start with I recently released my RA2 Siege of New York total conversion scenario converting Civ2’s world map into a cityscape where tanks & paratroopers battle it out between huge garrisoned skyscrapers. Commodore & REDY both created RA1 scenarios for Civ3 years ago where the allies & soviets battle over a large map of Europe. For Civ4 fans Doczo created a modmod of the popular Civ4 WW2 1939 mod based on RA1 but this time it’s an utterly huge map of Europe. And lastly there’s a Red Alert Civs mod for Civ5 by Usernamehere that adds Allies, Soviets and Yuri’s Psychic forces to the game. That appears to be all of them as there’s no Civ6 or 7 mods that we can find for now. Check out our mod cataloging forum thread for links & more information if any of our CivFanatics want to try these RA scenarios out.
